jobs.title: Director of Influencer Marketing - Americas
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

Summary:
The Director of Influencer Marketing will develop, execute and manage Influencer strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement in the Americas region for Huda Beauty. This role involves cultivating relationships with key media outlets, influencers, and stakeholders, creating impactful campaigns, and overseeing influencer partnerships to elevate brand's presence and credibility

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
:

Develop and implement regional influencer strategy and approach for Huda Beauty across micros, mid tier, macro and celeb level influencers for both short term and long term partnerships.
Identify new talent and influencers across new demographics and markets while continue to nurture existing influencer community while looking to
Collaborate with Global Marketing to ensure brand equity and storytelling are consistent, while developing and modifying plans based on regional needs
Strong collaboration with other departments (Brand, Agencies, E-commerce) to drive overall business needs and keeping teams up to speed on support that can be expected
Manage, plan & execute invite lists for regional and global events. Monitor performance and KPIs during and post activations
Work in partnership with Global teams to scale and evolve influencer seeding strategy, including lifestyle, wellness and "fragheads"
Lead and drive PR strategy in partenership with agency to ensure brand is top of mind and relevant across the editor community
Develop and manage the Influencer marketing budget, ensuring cost-effective strategies
Lead paid partnerships. Negotiate contracts and partnerships with influencers, ensuring briefs and deliverables are strategically aligned and KPIs achieved.
Stay on top of pop culture, social media, influencer trends, as well as emerging technologies and social media platforms and platform updates
Set strong KPIs, measure effectiveness and track learnings for all influencer campaigns leveraging analytical tools when needed. Distribute insights and learnings regularly with internal teams via monthly reporting.
Monitor expenses, analyze ROI, and adjust strategies accordingly

Requirements

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of influencer or related marketing experience
At least 4 years' experience in identifying, engaging, and working with celebrity, micro-influencers and editors
Proven track record of successful campaigns in the beauty or fragrance space and existing relationships with influencers or talent managers
Passion for building relationships and connecting with people
Exceptional written communication skills with keen attention to detail
Experience developing, executing and refining social and influencer strategies
Has a strong understanding of different social platforms and what content would perform best on each platform, content best practices, and organic/paid rights & usage
Obsessed with pop culture, social media, and a natural story-teller
Passionate about beauty with an intense desire to learn and explore ways to innovate in those areas
Self-starter, ability to thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment
Creative thinker to help drive exciting, disruptive content and campaigns promoting brand growth
Has a ‘no task too small' attitude

Benefits

Monthly "Self-Love Days" - at company discretion
401(k) matching contributions
Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
Hybrid working schedules (home & office)
Quarterly product gifting

The pay range for this role is $125k-$200k. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidates relevant work experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) team is a part of VBG. This role will be responsible for leading c ross-segment integrated marketing strategies and programs that would include initiatives touching Enterprise, Public Sector, and/or Business Markets across the CMO and Verizon Business Group. You will focus on marketing strategy, execution, performance management, and go-to-market plans relative to product launches, campaign pivots, and product promotions.

In this role, you will work in lockstep with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, CRM, Media, Creative, and Digital/Dotcom teams to build integrated programs in support of our Wireline Business. You will own internal communication of local campaign progress to all stakeholders, agency briefings, and GTM kickoffs while ensuring flawless execution. Additionally, you will serve as a flexible, agile contributor on the team, taking on other key IMC initiatives and special projects as business needs evolve. In this role, you will report to an Associate Director within the IMC segment team.

The IMC Senior Manager will lead the planning, briefing, management, execution, creative optimization, and reporting on Wireline multi-channel campaigns that drive to the sale funnel or direct to digital channels, increase awareness,and build long-term business relationships. You will have the authority and independence to ensure that requirements, communication opportunities, and risks are identified, managed, and completed in a timely fashion to achieve on-time completion of key deliverables.

Collaborating in lockstep with Product Marketing to define campaign objectives, align on strategies, and establish baseline briefs.
Partnering closely with the Media team to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs/GAs, and optimize local/regional media plans.
Working closely with Creative teams and agencies to analyze performance data and execute real-time creative pivots, A/B testing, and message testing when applicable.
Owning and managing the digital and Dotcom integration for your initiatives—ensuring seamless user journeys, landing page alignment, appointment-booking functionality, and strong cross-functional digital execution.
Authoring, owning, and presenting strategic briefs, local pilot presentations, and deck updates for multiple LOBs and leadership stakeholders.
Synthesizing media performance and local event ROI (GAs, leads, engagement) to share regular results, updates, and strategic recommendations out to leadership.
Managing complex, multi-faceted timelines with exceptional organizational skills to ensure all deliverables stay on strategy and on deadline.
Leading and supporting additional high-priority IMC initiatives and cross-functional projects outside of Wireline marketing as needed by the business.
Maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging trends to fill knowledge gaps and refine marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For…

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience working cross-functionally across Digital/Dotcom, Field Sales/Marketing, Product Marketing, and/or Media teams.
B2B Marketing experience.
Experience creating and presenting executive-level decks, performance readouts, and strategic briefs to Sr. Director-level leadership and above.
Experience translating market insights and data into compelling stories and sales enablement tools.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Master’s degree; preferably MBA.
Marketing experience in Wireline marketing, targeting Enterprise customers and prospects.
Experience working closely with Media and Creative teams to evaluate live campaign metrics and execute iterative creative pivots.
Strong organizational skills and proven ability to juggle multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot) to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support decision-making.
ABM/DBM/Content syndication experience.
Agency or consultant experience.
Proven digital/Dotcom marketing background with a solid understanding of web journeys, lead conversion pathways, and digital trends.
Strong project management background with high attention to detail and process optimization.
Agile mindset with the ability to easily adapt and step in on high-visibility adjacent projects.
Must be a team player and highly effective communicator capable of building strong cross-functional relationships.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

jobs.title: Principal, Head of Channel Marketing
jobs.description:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.

What We Do

As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

The Opportunity

Private markets continue to open to new investor bases, and the way capital is raised is being rewritten. Institutions are deepening their allocations. Evergreen and interval structures, expanding wealth platforms and advisor demand are bringing private markets to investors who have never had access before. The firms that win will understand every client segment better than anyone else and show up for each one with the right story, the right experience and the right timing.

The Head of Channel Marketing is a newly created role responsible for translating the firm’s commercial priorities into tailored marketing solutions for each client segment. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this leader will work with Marketing, Client Solutions, Product and Investment to identify where growth will come from, then design and execute the full-funnel programs that capture it.

The role owns segmentation and audience strategy, and uses client insight, pipeline data and campaign performance to direct marketing investment toward the segments, platforms and accounts with the greatest opportunity. The Head of Channel Marketing is accountable for commercial outcomes, including pipeline created and influenced, conversion, assets raised, and client retention, and will build the strategy, team and processes for the channel marketing team.

Your Responsibilities Will Be To

Define and own the channel marketing strategy and multi-year roadmap for each priority segment, tied to the firm’s commercial goals
Own audience strategy across institutional and private wealth, and continually refine it with client insight, market intelligence and performance data
Partner with Product and Product Marketing to ensure the brand narrative and product positioning are translated into segment-specific messaging pillars that are consistent across the firm and distinctive in the market
Design full-funnel, multi-channel programs that drive awareness, engagement, conversion and retention across the client lifecycle, with clear targets for lead generation, pipeline and assets raised
Support the full product and client lifecycle, from launch and capital raising through ongoing education, retention and expansion
Build a trusted partnership with Client Solutions, aligning segment priorities, pipeline goals and coverage models, and provide the teams with the content, tools and insight they need to win
Establish shared lead definitions, hand-offs and feedback loops between Marketing and Sales
Set measurable goals and KPIs for every campaign/program, and report on engagement, pipeline contribution, conversion, assets raised and marketing ROI
Own channel budgets and manage agency and media partners, from brief through delivery, reallocating investment based on performance

Your Background Will Include

12+ years of marketing experience in asset management, private markets, alternatives or wealth management, with at least 5 years leading teams
A record of building from scratch: a channel strategy, a segmentation model, a team or a function that did not exist before you, and the results it delivered
Proven commercial impact, with specific outcomes you can point to, such as pipeline created, conversion improved, or assets raised
Experience owning segmentation and audience strategy, and shifting budget toward the segments and accounts that produce growth
Hands-on use of AI, automation and marketing technology to launch faster, personalize at scale and improve campaign performance, with results you can quantify
Command of investment products, client segments, distribution partners and the regulatory requirements for marketing in financial services; experience across institutional and wealth or intermediary audiences is a plus
Strong digital, CRM, marketing automation and analytics skills, and the judgment to turn data into decisions
Clear, concise communication of complex investment ideas to different audiences
Experience managing budgets and agency partners

Benefits

At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring. To do this, Hamilton Lane offers the following benefits:

Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health

Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health & fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.

Developing Your Career

Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.

Supporting Your Family & Community

For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.

For growing family, we offer an adoption reimbursement program, paid time off for new parents and newlyweds, and provide travel support for nursing parents.

Safeguarding Your Financial Wellbeing

Hamilton Lane contributes to retirement programs and offers an employee stock purchasing plan.

Hamilton Lane is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic predisposition, veteran or military status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense or stalking, or any other classification prohibited by applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, please contact Human Resources at humanresources@hamiltonlane.com.

Hamilton Lane is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Hamilton Lane via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Hamilton Lane. No fee shall be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Hamilton Lane as a result of the referral or through other means.

jobs.title: Manager, Lifecycle Marketing - Banana Republic
jobs.description:
About Banana Republic

Banana Republic is a storyteller’s brand, outfitting the modern explorer with high-quality, expertly crafted collections made to inspire and enrich life’s journeys. Founded in 1978 in San Francisco, we continue to evolve our heritage of exploration through thoughtfully designed apparel and accessories that blend timeless style with exceptional craftsmanship.

Our team is made up of passionate, curious storytellers — creators and visionaries who seek out what’s next and bring it to life through elevated design, immersive experiences, and a shared spirit of creativity and innovation.

About The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager to be an essential role in continuous development, optimization and support for Banana Republic’s CRM and retention strategies. This data-driven, customer-focused individual will be an integral part of the CRM Retention marketing team whose objective is to understand customer behaviors that drive long term value, loyalty and engagement and identify opportunities for personalization across the customer lifecycle.

What you'll do

Own the lifecycle roadmap

Own the lifecycle and triggered program portfolio across Email, SMS, & Push (including high-intent behavioral triggers, post-purchase and order communications, low in stock, and loyalty) across all verticals, including BR Specialty and BR Factory, with a distinct plan for each customer.
Prioritize the highest-value customer moments over program count. Make the call on what to build, scale, fix, or stop.
Own lifecycle across Email, SMS, and Push so programs work together across channels, not alongside each other.
Partner with the teams that own batch communications so triggered and lifecycle programs complement them and customers get the right message at the right time.

Diagnose performance and tell the story

Own program-level performance reporting and know it cold. Diagnose what is moving and why, including year-over-year and week-over-week changes.
Separate real efficiency gains from mix shifts and volume effects, and attributed demand from incremental demand.
Reconcile data across sources and validate your numbers before they reach leadership.
Translate results into clear business implications for senior leaders: what happened, why it matters, and what we are doing about it.

Test and learn

Build and run a test agenda tied to real strategic questions: what is incremental, which customer should receive what, and how much communication is productive.
Read results carefully, know what a test actually proved, and make a clear scale, modify, or stop recommendation.

Move toward customer-level contact strategy

Help shape how we decide the best communication for a customer when they qualify for several at once.
Evaluate decisions on demand, engagement, and file health together, not demand alone.
Work with analytics and CRM partners to deepen personalization where it creates measurable value.

Execute with rigor

Run program builds, launches, and QA end to end with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, and our technology and vendor partners.
Manage timelines and hold partners accountable. Escalate early, with a recommendation attached.

Direct Mail (Retention)

Full end-to-end management of our retention Direct Mail program, including audience selection, creative briefing, execution and measuring incrementality and ROI.

Who you are

What Great Looks Like

Independent. You take an ambiguous problem from question to recommendation with minimal direction, and you bring solutions when you flag issues.
Strategic. You connect the tactical decision to the bigger customer and business question.
Analytical and precise. You are comfortable in the data, you check your own work, and you are careful not to claim more than the data supports.
An owner. Results, quality, and follow-through are yours, and partners trust you to deliver.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
5+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, preferably in retail or e-commerce
Hands-on experience owning triggered or lifecycle programs in an email service provider or marketing automation platform, as well as SMS and Push platforms for retail.
Strong analytical skills, including advanced Excel and comfort working with large datasets. SQL and Adobe Analytics are a plus
Working knowledge of test design and incrementality, and the judgment to separate correlation from causation
Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex results simple for senior audiences
Proven ability to work across teams and navigate a large company
Customer-obsessed, with a bias toward action

Salary Range:
$119,400.00 - $155,200.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Banana Republic

Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.
One of the most competitive Paid Time Off plans in the industry.*
Employees can take up to five “on the clock” hours each month to volunteer at a charity of their choice.*
Extensive 401(k) plan with company matching for contributions up to four percent of an employee’s base pay.*
Employee stock purchase plan.*
Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.*

It addresses challenges in family coordination and communication by developing simple, effective tools like a smart family calendar, which has reached millions of users. jobs.description:
Who We Are

Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, is the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences across Neiman Marcus, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Driven by a relentless devotion to our customers and powered by our talented colleagues, we offer expertly curated product assortments, unparalleled service and personalized experiences across our integrated retail model. Through strong partnerships with the world's most desired luxury brands and deep customer relationships enhanced by data-rich insights, Exemplar Luxury Group is committed to setting the standard of excellence for luxury retail.

Job Description

YOU WILL BE:

The Manager, Co-op & Brand Partner Marketing owns and grows a portfolio of strategic brand partnerships, serving as a trusted advisor to brand partners and a key commercial partner to ELG’s internal teams. Reporting to the Director, Co-op & Brand Partner Marketing, this role translates brand priorities, category insights and ELG business objectives into integrated marketing programs that drive partner investment, deliver measurable results and create value for both the partner and ELG.

The Manager leads the partnership lifecycle, from account planning and opportunity development through investment negotiation, cross-functional execution, performance measurement and future growth planning. Success requires strong commercial judgment, relationship-building skills, data-driven decision making and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization. This individual must be comfortable presenting recommendations, navigating complex business conversations and representing ELG credibly with senior brand partners and internal leaders. v

What You Will Do

Own day-to-day relationships and seasonal planning for an assigned portfolio of managed brand partners; build trust, understand each brand’s priorities, category performance, investment history and decision process, and serve as a strategic thought partner.
Build account plans and identify revenue opportunities across print, digital, onsite and offsite media, store experiences, events and other ELG marketing assets as appropriate.
Develop and present thoughtful proposals, investment recommendations and business cases that connect brand goals, customer insight, commercial priorities, available inventory and measurable outcomes.
Translate brand priorities into distinctive, integrated programs that deliver customer and commercial value to ELG while strengthening the long-term partnership.
Lead partner meetings and negotiate scope, investment and deliverables with tact and clarity; manage difficult conversations and escalate material commercial or relationship risks to the Director.
Present confidently to brand executives, agencies and internal leaders, representing ELG’s business, marketing capabilities and partnership point of view with credibility and sound judgment.
Partner with merchants and internal business leaders to understand assortment, receipts, category trends and seasonal priorities, and translate those insights into relevant brand opportunities.
Lead cross-functional stakeholder management across Creative, CRM, Social, Events, Store Marketing, Digital, Retail Media, Analytics, Finance, Merchandising and Partnership Operations; establish shared objectives, clarify roles, navigate competing priorities and keep decisions and deliverables moving.
Partner closely with Retail Media and agency teams to incorporate onsite and offsite media, sponsored products and relevant audience solutions into broader brand plans; align on strategy, investment, execution requirements, measurement and partner communication.
Maintain accurate pipeline, proposal, commitment and forecast records; track co-op revenue, partner investment and fulfillment against the assigned portfolio’s goals.
Review campaign and business performance, develop timely recaps, and use the results to recommend optimizations and future investment; communicate both progress and limitations clearly to partners.
Stay informed about ELG’s business, customer experience, marketing calendar and the competitive luxury and retail media landscape to represent the company credibly in partner meetings.
Contribute partner feedback, category ideas and practical process improvements to the Director’s broader co-op strategy and partnership offering.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

5+ years of experience in brand partnerships, account management, marketing, retail media or a related commercial role.
Demonstrated success managing partner relationships, developing account growth strategies and identifying opportunities to increase revenue or marketing investment.
Strong presentation, written communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to navigate sensitive commercial conversations and build productive relationships with senior stakeholders.
Experience developing proposals and translating business, customer, sales or campaign data into actionable recommendations and compelling partner-facing presentations.
Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities and drive projects forward without direct reporting authority.
Experience managing multiple accounts, projects or integrated marketing programs from planning through execution, measurement and recap.
Working knowledge of digital media and omnichannel marketing, with an understanding of how marketing investments support brand and business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications (nice To Haves)

Experience with luxury, fashion, beauty or multi-banner retail
Understanding of media or retail media, campaign measurement and e-commerce analytics; experience collaborating with or managing media agencies is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or equivalent practical experience.

Your Life And Career At Exemplar Luxury Group

Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
An amazing employee discount

jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong visual instincts, thoughtful craft, and the ability to turn a brief into clear, compelling creative. You’ll join Vivint’s Brand & Digital Design team and work with designers, copywriters, and marketing partners to bring advertising, brand campaigns, digital experiences, and customer communications to life.

You’ll contribute ideas, build thoughtful layouts, and carry projects through revisions and final production. The ideal designer is comfortable working within an established brand while finding opportunities to make the work feel fresh, useful, and cohesive.

What You'll Do

Design advertising and marketing creative across digital and customer marketing, including paid media, social, email, customer communications, and digital and print campaigns.
Develop creative for broader brand and advertising initiatives, including campaign concepts, web graphics, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Translate creative briefs and messaging into clear visual concepts, layouts, and finished designs.
Adapt creative across channels, sizes, and formats while maintaining consistent typography, color, imagery, and hierarchy.
Collaborate with copywriters, marketing partners, and other designers to align creative with audience needs and project goals.
Apply Vivint’s brand guidelines and contribute to reusable templates and design patterns that make recurring work more efficient.
Present work clearly, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and communicate progress and dependencies.
Prepare organized files and production-ready assets; check details, consistency, and accuracy before handoff.
Manage multiple projects and deadlines with support from the design team.

Minimum Qualifications

A portfolio that demonstrates strong typography, layout, composition, and brand application across digital and print work.
At least 2 years of relevant professional graphic design experience, including in-house, agency, or freelance work, with the ability to take assigned projects from brief through final delivery.
Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
Proficiency with generative AI tools to explore concepts, create and refine imagery and other creative assets, and integrate outputs into polished, on-brand advertising.
An understanding of designing for different formats and channels, including responsive digital layouts and print production.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to balance visual quality with clear communication.
A collaborative approach, openness to feedback, and the ability to explain your design decisions.
Good organization, time management, and communication skills.
A college degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio.
No professional certifications required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing integrated advertising campaigns across paid media, social, email, web, or print.
Experience working with brand systems, component libraries, or reusable creative templates.
Basic motion design or animation skills.
Experience partnering with digital marketing, Customer Marketing, or an in-house creative team.

Portfolio

Please include a portfolio with your application. We’d like to see examples of your design craft, how you apply a brand across different formats, and the role you played in the work.

To build your video marketing or social media portfolio.

Real, hands-on experience helping create content for local and national clients.
To learn how a short-form video idea moves from trend to final post.

Real Work, Real Experience

A majority of our full-time team started at Online Optimism as Specialists, and many of our Specialists go on to work at some of the top digital marketing agencies around.

jobs.description:
As a Google Cloud Premier Partner, we work with some of the most exciting companies across financial services, retail, technology, and emerging industries. What makes us different is our belief that technology alone doesn't create transformation. People do.

Today, tridorian operates across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the US, serving customers from startups to enterprise organizations. As we continue to grow, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to help shape the future of cloud, data, AI, and cybersecurity.

We believe great companies are built on great relationships.

Our culture is grounded in three core values:
Curiosity
: We continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and seek better solutions.
Trust
: We act with transparency, accountability, and ownership.
Courage
: We embrace challenges, drive change, and pursue ambitious goals.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing your expertise, collaborating with talented colleagues, and helping drive our continued growth and success. You'll be empowered to take ownership, develop your skills, and play an important role in shaping the future of tridorian.

About the Role

This is a new, permanent Field Marketing Manager role based in the USA, focusing on North America. You will be a mid-to-senior individual contributor responsible for driving our go-to-market strategies through impactful events, partner marketing, and sales enablement collateral.

Main Responsibilities

Own and maintain the North America event and campaign calendar, ensuring visibility and alignment with sales and leadership.
Plan and execute a variety of events across the US and Canada, managing content, agenda, speakers, and attendee experience.
Manage and report on partner marketing funds, including application, compliance, and budget utilization.
Develop and coordinate sales-facing collateral, including call scripts, sales talk tracks, one-pagers, and pitch decks.
Collaborate with the global marketing team to ensure alignment on brand initiatives and messaging.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including sales teams, Google, and external vendors.
Track event performance and report on pipeline and engagement impact.

Required Experience

4+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, or event marketing, preferably within a B2B tech or SaaS environment.
Proven experience managing co-op/partner marketing funds (MDF, PSF, or similar), including compliance and reporting.
Demonstrated success in planning and executing in-person events such as roundtables, dinners, and executive briefings.
Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies across different market segments, industries, and decision-maker personas.
Experience working closely with Sales teams to provide localized marketing support aligned with their needs.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, CRM tools, and analytics platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating with external partners and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience within the Google Cloud ecosystem.
Familiarity with marketing for tech companies focused on AI solutions.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?

Make an impact. Join PMI.

How will you make a difference to PMI?

The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The role defines how marketing, customer, product, and revenue data should be modeled, decides what each metric means, and ensures those definitions are implemented consistently across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language analytics.

The role combines hands-on technical depth with team leadership. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability.

Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context

Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree.
Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification.
Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data.
Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue.
Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions.
Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage.
Own the business questions, expected results, and synonym glossary behind the Verified Query Repository supporting Cortex Analyst and natural-language analytics.
Own the context layer that makes Marketing's data interpretable to analysts and AI agents, including entity descriptions, metric documentation, approved analytical uses, and known limitations of each source.
Diagnose discrepancies across Snowflake, BI, Adobe Analytics, marketing platforms, finance reporting, and operational systems.
Identify gaps in source data, identity resolution, event structures, and dimensional consistency before they become downstream reporting issues.
Define ownership boundaries between source systems, engineered data products, semantic models, and reporting layers.

Team Leadership and Capability

Lead, coach, and develop a team of three to four analysts spanning paid media, customer and lifecycle analytics, and digital analytics.
Set the Marketing Analytics roadmap, allocate the team against it, and manage intake and prioritization from across Marketing.
Establish and enforce analytical standards including SQL quality, peer review, testing, documentation, and reuse.
Review the team's models, queries, and analyses before they reach stakeholders, and hold the quality bar for what gets published.
Grow the team's depth in dimensional modeling, data modeling practice, and analytical rigor through direct coaching and review.
Manage performance, hiring, and development planning for the team.

Marketing Measurement and Performance Analytics

Define and govern core marketing KPIs including revenue, conversion, CAC and CPA, ROAS, retention, funnel progression, pacing to plan, and channel efficiency.
Own the integrity and narrative of recurring executive performance reporting, including monthly business reviews and QBR analytics, with the team producing the underlying analysis.
Determine how platform-reported, attribution-based, financial, and incrementality-based measures reconcile, and establish where each is appropriately used.
Lead attribution, cohort, and incrementality work so it produces decision-grade guidance on marketing investment, building the harder analyses directly.
Own predictive modeling for Marketing, including membership churn and renewal propensity, certification lapse and recertification likelihood, and product and cross-sell propensity, alongside segmentation, lifecycle, and cohort analysis across CRM, web, campaign, commerce, certification, and membership data.
Define the features, target definitions, validation approach, and performance thresholds for predictive models, determine when a score is reliable enough to act on, and establish how scores are refreshed, monitored for drift, and activated in campaign, lifecycle, and retention programs.
Set analytical standards for A/B testing, holdouts, geo experiments, and conversion-lift studies within the marketing analytics practice, including hypotheses, test populations, success metrics, and readouts.
Partner with Product and Marketing to define measurable funnels, customer states, lifecycle stages, and behavioral signals for considered-purchase journeys, and hold a clear distinction between attribution, correlation, prediction, and causal measurement when results are communicated.

Analytics Delivery and Enablement

Govern Marketing's analytical products in enterprise BI and visualization platforms, ensuring definitions are sourced from the semantic layer rather than rebuilt in the tool.
Use Adobe Analytics to investigate digital behavior, traffic, customer journeys, and conversion performance, and work with data from Adobe Experience Platform, CRM, commerce, and paid media systems.
Apply working knowledge of digital event instrumentation, tagging, identity, and schemas to identify measurement and architecture issues at the source, and establish where AI-assisted tooling is applied to SQL development, analysis, documentation, and testing.
Expand governed self-service and AI-assisted analytics for Marketing across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language surfaces, and represent Marketing data and context requirements in the Marketing AI reference architecture.
Define what Marketing data and context AI agents and natural-language tools are permitted to reach, at what grain, and under what access and accuracy controls, and own the evaluation approach that tests answer accuracy before release and monitors it as data and definitions change.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as Marketing's primary analytical counterpart to Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Governance.
Translate business questions into analytical requirements and data-product specifications that engineering can build against.
Partner with Data Engineering on transformation logic, data contracts, source integration, model design, and data-quality requirements.
Partner with Performance Marketing, Brand, Digital, Product, Lifecycle, and Regional Marketing on measurement needs and analytical priorities.
Present analytical findings, performance trends, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Scope of Role

Leads a team of three to four analysts covering marketing, customer, and performance analytics, while personally designing analytical data models and validating them. Accountable for Marketing's business data architecture, metric definitions, context layer, predictive models, and executive performance reporting across certification, membership, e-learning, events, and other product lines.

Hands-on ownership concentrates in data model design, metric reconciliation, predictive model validation, evaluation of analytical accuracy, and diagnosis of cross-system discrepancies. Semantic view implementation sits with the Snowflake team, built to this role's specification. Routine reporting, campaign analysis, and dashboard production sit with the team, under this role's review and standards.

Data Engineering, Technology, and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, platform access, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. Enterprise data governance policy, cataloging, and cross-domain stewardship sit outside this role; the incumbent partners with Data Governance and applies those standards within Marketing.

Role Qualifications

10+ years across marketing analytics, customer analytics, analytics engineering, or related disciplines, including prior leadership of an analytics team.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing an analytics team while remaining hands-on technically.
Working knowledge of ETL and ELT concepts, transformation pipelines, data dependencies, and data-quality controls, with the ability to read, review, and challenge logic developed by engineering teams.
Experience working within layered, dimensional, or medallion data architectures.
Experience integrating and analyzing data across CRM, marketing, digital, commerce, and transactional systems.
Development and governance of analytical products in an enterprise BI platform, preferred.
Customer data platform architecture including identity resolution, event schema design, and audience activation.
Marketing measurement including attribution, experimentation, incrementality, conversion, CAC and CPA, and ROAS, and experience directing or building predictive and propensity models such as churn or retention.
Advanced SQL including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, data profiling, reconciliation, and validation, applied to large-scale datasets.
Working hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform, sufficient to profile, query, validate, and reconcile at scale.
Demonstrated experience designing business and analytical data models, and specifying them for engineering teams to build against.
Dimensional modeling including facts, dimensions, grain, cardinality, slowly changing dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions.
Metric governance, lineage, and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems.
Strong analytical storytelling and executive communication.
Familiarity with semantic layer and context technologies such as Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, dbt Semantic Layer, or Looker, preferred.
Digital analytics using an enterprise web analytics platform, preferred.
dbt or comparable SQL transformation framework, preferred.
Python or R for advanced analysis, automation, or modeling, preferred.
Git and version-controlled analytics development, preferred.
Data testing and observability frameworks, preferred.
Marketing mix modeling, geo experimentation, conversion lift, causal-inference methods, and machine learning applied to churn, propensity, or lifetime value, preferred.
Up to 10% if required.

What you can expect from us

We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you..

Join Us And You’ll Get

an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location.
skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future.
access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience.
flexible options to help balance work time and your time

jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About The Role

The Director, Strategy is a high-impact business consultant responsible for defining the overarching vision

and multi-service roadmap for SmartBug's medium and large accounts. While Marketing Strategy remains

the primary engine of growth and the core of the client's strategic focus, this role brings the business

acumen to factor in cross-functional approaches—such as AI, Web, PR, and technical integrations—to

create a unified competitive advantage.

As the final touchpoint for strategic deliverables, the Director ensures that every plan is sophisticated,

integrated, and aligned with the client's long-term business objectives. The Director provides high-level

vision and relies on a team of Strategists and Specialists to handle day-to-day execution.

The Director, Strategy Will Be Measured On

Strategic Excellence: Quality and innovation of the overall marketing and business roadmap.
Sales Impact: Contribution to closing and correctly scoping large and medium accounts.
Client Satisfaction: Long-term results, ROI attainment, and executive-level trust, including the

ability to communicate with C-level executives on client accounts.

Pod Performance: Success and professional development of the team members in the pod.

What You'll Do

Integrated Marketing & Business Strategy

Marketing-Led Vision: Act as the primary architect of the client's marketing engine, ensuring demand generation, brand positioning, and content strategy are the core drivers of ROI.
Cross-Functional Synthesis: Evaluate how non-marketing business functions (e.g., AI automation, technical API integrations, and PR-led authority) can be leveraged to amplify the core marketing strategy.
Full-Lifecycle Alignment: Ensure the marketing strategy seamlessly transitions into sales enablement and customer success, creating a closed-loop system that factors in the entire business operation.
Service Ecosystem Orchestration: Move beyond "HubSpot-only" thinking to determine when a client requires specialized services like web development or advanced data integrations to remove friction from the marketing funnel.

Strategic Governance & Vision

Quarterly Steering: Lead high-impact strategic sessions with client executives to pivot the vision based on market trends, ensuring marketing efforts remain agile and business-relevant.
Final Strategic Touchpoint: Review and refine all major strategic deliverables to ensure they reflect a holistic business perspective before they reach the client.
Strategic ROI Benchmarking: Define how marketing KPIs translate into broader business outcomes like Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and overall revenue growth.

Sales Growth & Collaboration

Strategic Scoping: Partner with the Sales team to identify gaps where a client's core marketing goals could be better supported by PR, AI, or technical services, ensuring the initial scope is comprehensive.
Vision Selling: Assist sales reps by articulating the "Total SmartBug Advantage," showing prospects how marketing strategy acts as the foundation for a wider business transformation.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years in digital strategy or business consulting, with a focus on cross-departmental integration
Business acumen to converse with C-suite executives about business goals, not just marketing tactics
Consultative maturity to steer C-suite conversations away from tactical "to-do lists"; toward high-level business strategy and resource allocation
Familiarity with how PR, SEO, Web Development, and AI tools integrate into a modern marketing and sales engine

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

Experience working directly in a HubSpot partner agency

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As a Global Enterprise and Public Sector ABM/DBM Marketing Senior Manager, you’ll be the strategic engine delivering 1:1 Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and Deal-Based Marketing (DBM) strategy and program development for key accounts within the Verizon Business segment. You will act as a highly specialized individual contributor, partnering closely with Verizon sellers and account teams to define the right approach to deliver on account objectives and drive targeted wins.

Your efforts will directly support Sales account managers, delivering on Reputation, Relationship, Revenue (Pipeline) and Retention KPIs. You will be responsible for defining our ABM/DBM approach by applying defensible account selection criteria, conducting deep account discovery for identified accounts, and developing sophisticated strategies to influence key members of buying committees. Success means using deep insights and AI-driven tools to uncover account intelligence, identify new contacts, create new opportunities, secure new meetings, move opportunities through the funnel faster, and improve the win rate for the accounts in our ABM and DBM programs.

Owning and crafting well-composed ABM and DBM strategic marketing plans, driving accountability for delivering programs that meet agreed-upon business targets.
Conducting deep account discovery to understand Enterprise and Public Sector organizations, how they buy technology products, and the key motivators of their buying committee members.
Working closely and collaboratively with Enterprise and Public Sector Sales leadership and account owners to drive shared accountability in the success of ABM and DBM programs.
Designing activation programs for targeted ABM/DBM accounts and building or sourcing assets mapped to the customer/buyer journey and aligned with specific personas to help sales identify and accelerate opportunities.
Leveraging AI tools and the full Verizon MarTech stack to deliver advanced relevance and personalization for all ABM and DBM assets.
Ensuring all projects are aligned with established strategy, managing timelines and remaining actively aware of program details and deliverable statuses at all times.
Reporting out to peers and senior leadership on the progress and impact of ABM and DBM initiatives via a regularly-maintained dashboard.

What We’re Looking For…

You are a strategic marketer who understands the intricacies of B2B technology sales for Enterprise and Public Sector organizations. You know how to map out a complex buying committee and design personalized, multi-touch campaigns that resonate with multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with sales teams and leveraging the latest technologies to gain an edge.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Enterprise and/or Public Sector B2B marketing experience.
Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
Experience creating and executing marketing programs and campaigns, and reporting results to senior leadership.
Experience building presentation decks that are clear and concise, with a focus on executive design and succinct storytelling.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Deal-Based Marketing (DBM) experience.
Ability to analyze results, identify gaps, and successfully pivot strategies to deliver outcomes.
Ability to build executive-level relationships and drive complex initiatives across matrixed teams.
Strong understanding of Verizon Business wireless and wireline products.
Deep familiarity with Enterprise and Public Sector buying motions, including how to identify, map, and influence key buying committee members across numerous industries and verticals.
Proficiency with AI tools and modern marketing technology stacks to drive personalization and deep account discovery.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) team is a part of VBG. This role will be responsible for leading c ross-segment integrated marketing strategies and programs that would include initiatives touching Enterprise, Public Sector, and/or Business Markets across the CMO and Verizon Business Group. You will focus on marketing strategy, execution, performance management, and go-to-market plans relative to product launches, campaign pivots, and product promotions.

In this role, you will work in lockstep with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, CRM, Media, Creative, and Digital/Dotcom teams to build integrated programs in support of our Wireline Business. You will own internal communication of local campaign progress to all stakeholders, agency briefings, and GTM kickoffs while ensuring flawless execution. Additionally, you will serve as a flexible, agile contributor on the team, taking on other key IMC initiatives and special projects as business needs evolve. In this role, you will report to an Associate Director within the IMC segment team.

The IMC Senior Manager will lead the planning, briefing, management, execution, creative optimization, and reporting on Wireline multi-channel campaigns that drive to the sale funnel or direct to digital channels, increase awareness,and build long-term business relationships. You will have the authority and independence to ensure that requirements, communication opportunities, and risks are identified, managed, and completed in a timely fashion to achieve on-time completion of key deliverables.

Collaborating in lockstep with Product Marketing to define campaign objectives, align on strategies, and establish baseline briefs.
Partnering closely with the Media team to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs/GAs, and optimize local/regional media plans.
Working closely with Creative teams and agencies to analyze performance data and execute real-time creative pivots, A/B testing, and message testing when applicable.
Owning and managing the digital and Dotcom integration for your initiatives—ensuring seamless user journeys, landing page alignment, appointment-booking functionality, and strong cross-functional digital execution.
Authoring, owning, and presenting strategic briefs, local pilot presentations, and deck updates for multiple LOBs and leadership stakeholders.
Synthesizing media performance and local event ROI (GAs, leads, engagement) to share regular results, updates, and strategic recommendations out to leadership.
Managing complex, multi-faceted timelines with exceptional organizational skills to ensure all deliverables stay on strategy and on deadline.
Leading and supporting additional high-priority IMC initiatives and cross-functional projects outside of Wireline marketing as needed by the business.
Maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging trends to fill knowledge gaps and refine marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For…

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience working cross-functionally across Digital/Dotcom, Field Sales/Marketing, Product Marketing, and/or Media teams.
B2B Marketing experience.
Experience creating and presenting executive-level decks, performance readouts, and strategic briefs to Sr. Director-level leadership and above.
Experience translating market insights and data into compelling stories and sales enablement tools.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Master’s degree; preferably MBA.
Marketing experience in Wireline marketing, targeting Enterprise customers and prospects.
Experience working closely with Media and Creative teams to evaluate live campaign metrics and execute iterative creative pivots.
Strong organizational skills and proven ability to juggle multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot) to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support decision-making.
ABM/DBM/Content syndication experience.
Agency or consultant experience.
Proven digital/Dotcom marketing background with a solid understanding of web journeys, lead conversion pathways, and digital trends.
Strong project management background with high attention to detail and process optimization.
Agile mindset with the ability to easily adapt and step in on high-visibility adjacent projects.
Must be a team player and highly effective communicator capable of building strong cross-functional relationships.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As a Global Enterprise and Public Sector ABM/DBM Marketing Senior Manager, you’ll be the strategic engine delivering 1:1 Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and Deal-Based Marketing (DBM) strategy and program development for key accounts within the Verizon Business segment. You will act as a highly specialized individual contributor, partnering closely with Verizon sellers and account teams to define the right approach to deliver on account objectives and drive targeted wins.

Your efforts will directly support Sales account managers, delivering on Reputation, Relationship, Revenue (Pipeline) and Retention KPIs. You will be responsible for defining our ABM/DBM approach by applying defensible account selection criteria, conducting deep account discovery for identified accounts, and developing sophisticated strategies to influence key members of buying committees. Success means using deep insights and AI-driven tools to uncover account intelligence, identify new contacts, create new opportunities, secure new meetings, move opportunities through the funnel faster, and improve the win rate for the accounts in our ABM and DBM programs.

Owning and crafting well-composed ABM and DBM strategic marketing plans, driving accountability for delivering programs that meet agreed-upon business targets.
Conducting deep account discovery to understand Enterprise and Public Sector organizations, how they buy technology products, and the key motivators of their buying committee members.
Working closely and collaboratively with Enterprise and Public Sector Sales leadership and account owners to drive shared accountability in the success of ABM and DBM programs.
Designing activation programs for targeted ABM/DBM accounts and building or sourcing assets mapped to the customer/buyer journey and aligned with specific personas to help sales identify and accelerate opportunities.
Leveraging AI tools and the full Verizon MarTech stack to deliver advanced relevance and personalization for all ABM and DBM assets.
Ensuring all projects are aligned with established strategy, managing timelines and remaining actively aware of program details and deliverable statuses at all times.
Reporting out to peers and senior leadership on the progress and impact of ABM and DBM initiatives via a regularly-maintained dashboard.

What We’re Looking For…

You are a strategic marketer who understands the intricacies of B2B technology sales for Enterprise and Public Sector organizations. You know how to map out a complex buying committee and design personalized, multi-touch campaigns that resonate with multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with sales teams and leveraging the latest technologies to gain an edge.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Enterprise and/or Public Sector B2B marketing experience.
Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
Experience creating and executing marketing programs and campaigns, and reporting results to senior leadership.
Experience building presentation decks that are clear and concise, with a focus on executive design and succinct storytelling.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Deal-Based Marketing (DBM) experience.
Ability to analyze results, identify gaps, and successfully pivot strategies to deliver outcomes.
Ability to build executive-level relationships and drive complex initiatives across matrixed teams.
Strong understanding of Verizon Business wireless and wireline products.
Deep familiarity with Enterprise and Public Sector buying motions, including how to identify, map, and influence key buying committee members across numerous industries and verticals.
Proficiency with AI tools and modern marketing technology stacks to drive personalization and deep account discovery.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Oversee PNCU’s social media presence and digital content to strengthen member engagement, community awareness, and the Credit Union’s brand and reputation.
Coordinate and oversee promotional, community, and professional events, including planning, marketing support, materials, and implementation.
Develop and maintain relationships with community organizations, business partners, marketing vendors, and other external partners.
Collaborate with senior leadership and departments throughout PNCU to identify marketing needs and develop strategies that support products, services, organizational initiatives, and member growth.
