jobs.title: Performance Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
Great marketing happens when people who have a problem or a need can connect with great organizations who can help them. When you are marketing at Idaho Youth Ranch, that concept takes on a whole new meaning: Young people and their families come to Idaho Youth Ranch seeking healing and hope from traumas that are keeping them from living up to their full potential.

Our brand is more than colors and fonts on social media. It is about hope and resilience.

The Performance Marketing Strategist at Idaho Youth Ranch plays an essential role in helping connect families and young people who are facing adversity, trauma, and loss with caring adults who will help them get the safety and support they need to heal.

You will be putting your unique talents and skills to work to redefine the future for Idaho’s kids while being part of a supportive team environment.

How does Idaho Youth Ranch view their brand and communications?
Idaho Youth Ranch is a diverse organization with unique marketing needs. From marketing 24 thrift stores, a car lot, and an ecommerce department to managing marketing campaigns for a statewide network of life-changing programs, our Performance Marketing Strategist must be able to see the big picture to help the public understand that when kids need help, we are here and anyone who cares about Idaho’s kids can help through donations, volunteerism, or shopping.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use the elements of branding to tell a cohesive story to anyone who interacts with our organization.

So, who are we?
Since 1953, Idaho Youth Ranch has provided healing and hope for Idaho’s kids. We use proven therapies and programs to help kids who have experienced loss or adversity transform childhood trauma into hope. We offer a statewide network of services to kids 9–24 years old and their families, including outpatient therapies, residential care, adoption services, and career readiness.

The Idaho Youth Ranch is one of the oldest non-profit agencies in the state of Idaho. Our mission:

We unite for Idaho’s youth by providing accessible programs and services that nurture hope, healing, and resilience.

Why unite with us?
Because we are better together! Our team members enjoy a workplace where Relationships
are the foundation, where we are all Committed
to the same mission, where Growth
is always possible, where we are treated with and show Compassion
, where trust guides us to Transparency
, and above all, where Joy
sustains us.

What do we offer?
In addition to contributing to our awesome mission, working at IYR has many advantages! Affordable medical and dental care, other voluntary benefits offerings, a 401(k) match, paid time off, an employee discount on purchases at our thrift stores, and working in a caring and compassionate environment just to name a few.

How will you impact our mission?
Every position at Idaho Youth Ranch contributes to the success of our mission. As the Performance Marketing Strategist, your work directly impacts our ability provide life-changing therapies to the youth we serve. You play a lead role in helping parents of Idaho’s most vulnerable youth learn Idaho Youth Ranch can provide the healing and hope they need. As a leader in our branding, website, and social media, you play a critical role in public understanding and support for Idaho Youth Ranch.

Your design skills and messaging skills play a key role in communication both within Idaho Youth Ranch and in in the broader community. Your work is often the public face of Idaho Youth Ranch and plays an important role in perceptions of Idaho Youth Ranch.

Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or related field
2+ years of digital communications experience
Demonstrated success in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that drive measurable results.
Strong, hands-on Google Ads experience is required, including campaign build and account structure, keyword and audience strategy, Performance Max, budget and bid management, conversion tracking, and performance reporting.

Experience applying paid media to both talent acquisition (recruiting) and retail customer acquisition, with the ability to manage separate campaign strategies and budgets for each.
Working knowledge of TikTok as a marketing channel, including short-form video content and TikTok paid advertising.
Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager to measure, attribute, and report campaign performance.

Our Performance Marketing Strategist Will

Recommend, develop, and execute paid media campaigns to support staff recruiting, including hands-on management of Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, and display) and Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram to drive qualified applicant volume.
Build, manage, and optimize recruiting ad campaigns end to end, including audience targeting, creative and copy testing, budget pacing, bid strategy, and conversion tracking, to reduce cost per qualified applicant and shorten time to fill.
Grow and manage TikTok as a core social enterprise channel, producing short-form video content, leveraging trends and creator partnerships, and running TikTok paid placements to reach thrift shoppers and vehicle donors.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
National Forest Foundation (NFF)
is pleased to offer an exempt, full-time position who will be responsible for managing NFF's social media presence including strategy, content, community, and results. The Social Media Manager is a chance for a curious, culture-obsessed storyteller and strategist who sees endless possibility to grow NFF's social presence into the online place people visit to fall in love with forests, deepening this appreciation for themselves and, ultimately, supporting the NFF so we can preserve these landscapes for future generations.

About the NFF:
The National Forest Foundation, chartered by Congress in 1990, is the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS). In recent years, the Foundation has grown significantly in organizational capacity, revenue, and programmatic impact. Today, the NFF works with people, partners and communities across the country to restore forests and watersheds; make forests more resilient to wildfire; and ensure accessible and sustainable opportunities for recreation in our National Forests. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country's 193-million-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals building toward a bold future: a world where caring for our forests is second nature.

Position Function:
The Social Media Manager reports to the Marketing Director and is a growth-oriented position for someone who finds a way to turn NFF's mission and on-the-ground impact into scroll-stopping, share-worthy stories, with a particular emphasis on video. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, the Content & Creative team, and teams across the organization, this role considers the “we over me” approach to collaboration and translates local conservation projects into stories that resonate locally and nationally. Success will be measured by growth in reach, engagement, and community.

Position Duties and Responsibilities:
The Social Media Manager will:

Social Media Strategy & Growth

Develop and own an audience-centered organic social media strategy aligned with NFF's brand, marketing and advancement priorities and organizational goals
Assess target audience, distinct platform fit, and strategic priorities to decide where NFF should invest, which channels get full strategic and day-to-day ownership, and which get a lighter footprint, and evolve that approach over time as audiences and platforms shift
Establish channel-specific objectives, key performance indicators and growth targets, and demonstrate measurable growth in reach, engagement, followers, and other measurable audience actions
Monitor platform changes, audience behavior, cultural conversations and emerging trends to keep NFF's presence current, relevant and a step ahead
Develop and maintain an integrated social media content calendar aligned with high-level marketing strategy, organizational strategy, conservation priorities, seasonal moments and audience interests
Partner with NFF's growth marketing agency, sharing data, learning outcomes and insight that fuels larger acquisition and fundraising campaigns

Analytics, Testing & Optimization

Monitor and analyze channel, content, audience and campaign performance, and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations
Design and run structured tests across formats, creative approaches, messages and calls to action; document findings and apply learning going forward
Identify the organic content that resonates most, and use a designated amplification budget to extend its reach to new and existing audiences
Build and maintain social media dashboards and reports that communicate results, lessons learned and opportunities to drive goals; recommend key performance indicators that support marketing and organization-wide strategy

Community, Creator & Influencer Engagement

Manage NFF's social communities daily, responding to comments and messages, encouraging conversation, and cultivating relationships with followers, fans and supporters
Use social listening to understand audience interests, monitor sentiment, and uncover emerging engagement opportunities as well as potential risks to reputation
Own direct relationship management with a select set of creators and community voices, while partnering with NFF's influencer agency of record, which leads vetting, contracting and logistics for broader creator and influencer campaigns
Apply sound judgment when responding to marketplace influences, misinformation or sensitive issues, and follow escalation and response protocols for emerging or rapidly developing situations

Content Creation

Translate complex conservation projects and technical subject matter into clear, actionable creative briefs to inspire engaging and share-worthy content development
Oversee and guide social content development, inspiring content creators to consider scroll-stopping hooks, pacing, narrative structure and calls to action aligned with each platform
Create compelling, platform-native content including copy, graphics, photography and, especially, short-form video, adapting stories and assets to the audience, format and best practices of each platform
Build strong relationships across NFF to maintain a steady pipeline of timely, representative and geographically diverse stories to fuel storytelling across social platforms
Build familiarity with wide-ranging creative assets and identify opportunities to repurpose video, photography or copy into multiple platform-specific formats
Serve as a brand steward, ensuring social content is consistent with NFF's voice, look and feel; maintain accuracy, accessibility and editorial standards across all social content

Collaboration

Collaborate with email, web, fundraising, communications, partnerships and field teams to build coordinated, cross-channel campaigns
Ensure social media supports email acquisition, donor engagement, fundraising and program participation without directly owning those functions
Share social media guidance, content co-creation ideas and performance insights with colleagues, partners and key stakeholders

Education and Qualifications:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following education and experience:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of experience managing social media, developing dashboards and making data-informed decisions for a national brand, with a track record of significant organic audience growth
Experience using a designated budget to boost or amplify organic content, and comfort partnering with an agency on broader paid social campaigns
Proficiency with social media management and scheduling tools, social listening tools, and analytics platforms (e.g., Meta Business Suite, native platform analytics, Sprout Social, Google Analytics or similar)
Strong hands-on video production and editing skills, including short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook
Experience collaborating with outside agencies, freelancers or contractors
Must be authorized to work in the United States

Abilities and Skills:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following abilities and skills:

Deeply curious and addicted to culture and what's trending, someone who doesn't just find the inspiration, but delivers it for others
Strategic thinker who can weigh audience, platform and data to decide where to invest, then adapt that thinking as things change
Natural storyteller with a filmmaker's eye for the shot, sound and moment that stops the scroll
Collaborative partner who values diverse input and works comfortably with agencies, creators and teams across the organization
Owns and advocates for audience-first perspective; listens to community feedback and adjusts tone and approach; warm, welcoming and inclusive communicator
Self-starter comfortable with ambiguity and energized by change; treats every test, win or miss as a chance to learn and grow
Sees the big picture, connecting everyday content to NFF's long-term mission and impact
Exercises sound judgment on sensitive or reputationally sensitive topics
Growth mindset with a bias toward action and follow-through

Location:
This is a remote/work-from-home position open to candidates in the lower 48 states. Reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace are required. Occasional travel for team gatherings or content capture may be expected.

Compensation:
NFF offers a competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects our total rewards strategy. The salary range for this position is $95,000 with the ability to grow to $118,750 based on performance over time. Starting salary within this range is determined by a combination of experience, internal equity with comparable roles, and organizational budget, and is assessed annually as part of NFF's compensation review process.

Benefits:
NFF is proud to offer our staff:

Health and Wellness

Medical and dental insurance paid at 75% by the organization for you and any dependents
Vision insurance paid 50% by the organization for you and any dependents
Health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, predicated on coverage type
Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Employee assistance program (EAP) at no cost

Financial Wellbeing

403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match after one (1) year of service
Short-term and long-term disability insurance at no cost
Basic life and AD&D insurance at no cost, with voluntary life insurance options

Flexibility and Time Off

Employees start with 35 days of annual leave, sick leave, personal leave and holidays
Family & medical leave for up to sixteen (16) weeks with up to four (4) weeks paid

Personal Development

Training & Development Programs
Professional development reimbursement up to $1,000 per year

Journey of a Lifetime

The opportunity to support an incredible mission and travel to / work in spectacular locations

To Apply:
Applications must include both a cover letter and resume. Incomplete packages will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting will close on November, 21st, or earlier if filled. Please visit our careers site to apply online.

The National Forest Foundation is an equal opportunity employer — meaning we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable law. Further, we prohibit discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, and termination. We strive to foster a work environment where every individual is respected, valued, and treated fairly. This statement reflects our unwavering dedication to fairness,

jobs.description:
Description

Advantage Truck Group (ATG) is accelerating its digital transformation, and we are looking for a proactive, detailed-oriented Marketing Program Manager (Digital & CRM) with 2–3 years of experience to join our team.

Reporting directly to the Director of Marketing, this role will serve as the central execution engine behind ATG’s upcoming CRM rollout and ongoing multi-channel digital strategy. You will own day-to-day operations across email automation, website strategy, search and answer engine optimization (SEO/AEO), digital ad campaigns, and local listing management across our 8 dealerships.

This position is primarily remote, offering day-to-day flexibility to work from home. However, because close collaboration with dealership operations is key to our strategy, candidates must reside within a reasonable driving distance of our New England locations in Massachusetts, Vermont and New Hampshire for onsite meetings 1–2 times per month or as needed.

Duties & Responsibilities

CRM & Email Marketing Automation
Support the rollout and ongoing operations of our new CRM platform.
Map customer lifecycle journeys, configure audience segmentations, and build automated email nurture sequences.
Coordinate email campaign deployment, monitor lifecycle performance, and continuously optimize open and conversion rates.

Website Management & Organic Strategy (SEO / AEO):
Execute ongoing website content updates and maintain technical SEO hygiene.
Optimize site assets for traditional search rankings (SEO) as well as emerging AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) to keep ATG visible in conversational discovery.

Paid & Display Campaign Support:
Manage campaign schedules, route ad creative, and track campaign timelines across paid search, display, and digital ad channels.
Maintain tracking tags, UTM links, and analytics reports to measure campaign ROI.

Local Presence & Google Business Profile (GBP) Management:
Serve as the primary owner for ATG's Google Business Profiles across all dealership locations.
Monitor GBP updates, manage customer reviews, post regular business updates, and ensure business info remains accurate to drive local search engagement.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Collaborate directly with internal creative assets, external vendors, and dealership leadership to keep digital marketing programs and deliverables on schedule.

Requirements

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a creative flair for content development
Familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) or Canva
Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to make informed decisions
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work in a fast-paced environment
Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and drive results
Must reside within driving distance of ATG dealership facilities in MA, VT, or NH to support periodic in-person meetings and local initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements

2-3 years related experience in digital marketing, email execution, or marketing automation.
Bachelor’s degree with concentration in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred
Hands-on experience working with modern CRMs/Marketing Automation Platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Sugar CRM, or equivalent).
Experience with content management systems (e.g., WordPress or similar CMS platforms).
Current Valid Driver’s License

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated hiring or recruitment range for this position is $68-88K.
The actual salary offered will be commensurate with the qualifications, education and experience of the candidate hired.
FULL BENEFITS DAY ONE
Medical, dental and vision insurance
Short and Long Term Disability - Company paid
Life Insurance - Company paid
Paid time off - 15 days* during first year (*prorated to hire date)
Paid holidays - 7 per year
401K with 4% match

Culture

Career advancement opportunities
Company training programs
Employee driven continuous improvement programs
Performance recognition and rewards program
Supportive leadership
Learning environment

Advantage Truck Group (ATG)
is the largest Western Star and Freightliner dealer in New England with eight locations in Massachusetts, Vermont and New Hampshire, focused on providing a superior employee experience. ATG offers exciting career development opportunities through company paid training, and apprentice, co-op and internship programs. The company also actively gives back to the community through its charitable Haulin' 4 Hunger initiative along with supporting SkillsUSA.

At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Summary:
The Director of Influencer Marketing will develop, execute and manage Influencer strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement in the Americas region for Huda Beauty. This role involves cultivating relationships with key media outlets, influencers, and stakeholders, creating impactful campaigns, and overseeing influencer partnerships to elevate brand's presence and credibility

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
:

Develop and implement regional influencer strategy and approach for Huda Beauty across micros, mid tier, macro and celeb level influencers for both short term and long term partnerships.
Identify new talent and influencers across new demographics and markets while continue to nurture existing influencer community while looking to
Collaborate with Global Marketing to ensure brand equity and storytelling are consistent, while developing and modifying plans based on regional needs
Strong collaboration with other departments (Brand, Agencies, E-commerce) to drive overall business needs and keeping teams up to speed on support that can be expected
Manage, plan & execute invite lists for regional and global events. Monitor performance and KPIs during and post activations
Work in partnership with Global teams to scale and evolve influencer seeding strategy, including lifestyle, wellness and "fragheads"
Lead and drive PR strategy in partenership with agency to ensure brand is top of mind and relevant across the editor community
Develop and manage the Influencer marketing budget, ensuring cost-effective strategies
Lead paid partnerships. Negotiate contracts and partnerships with influencers, ensuring briefs and deliverables are strategically aligned and KPIs achieved.
Stay on top of pop culture, social media, influencer trends, as well as emerging technologies and social media platforms and platform updates
Set strong KPIs, measure effectiveness and track learnings for all influencer campaigns leveraging analytical tools when needed. Distribute insights and learnings regularly with internal teams via monthly reporting.
Monitor expenses, analyze ROI, and adjust strategies accordingly

Requirements

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of influencer or related marketing experience
At least 4 years' experience in identifying, engaging, and working with celebrity, micro-influencers and editors
Proven track record of successful campaigns in the beauty or fragrance space and existing relationships with influencers or talent managers
Passion for building relationships and connecting with people
Exceptional written communication skills with keen attention to detail
Experience developing, executing and refining social and influencer strategies
Has a strong understanding of different social platforms and what content would perform best on each platform, content best practices, and organic/paid rights & usage
Obsessed with pop culture, social media, and a natural story-teller
Passionate about beauty with an intense desire to learn and explore ways to innovate in those areas
Self-starter, ability to thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment
Creative thinker to help drive exciting, disruptive content and campaigns promoting brand growth
Has a ‘no task too small' attitude

401(k) matching contributions
Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
Hybrid working schedules (home & office)
Quarterly product gifting

The pay range for this role is $125k-$200k. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidates relevant work experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

new_jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Senior Manager
new_jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) team is a part of VBG. This role will be responsible for leading c ross-segment integrated marketing strategies and programs that would include initiatives touching Enterprise, Public Sector, and/or Business Markets across the CMO and Verizon Business Group. You will focus on marketing strategy, execution, performance management, and go-to-market plans relative to product launches, campaign pivots, and product promotions.

In this role, you will work in lockstep with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, CRM, Media, Creative, and Digital/Dotcom teams to build integrated programs in support of our Wireline Business. You will own internal communication of local campaign progress to all stakeholders, agency briefings, and GTM kickoffs while ensuring flawless execution. Additionally, you will serve as a flexible, agile contributor on the team, taking on other key IMC initiatives and special projects as business needs evolve. In this role, you will report to an Associate Director within the IMC segment team.

The IMC Senior Manager will lead the planning, briefing, management, execution, creative optimization, and reporting on Wireline multi-channel campaigns that drive to the sale funnel or direct to digital channels, increase awareness,and build long-term business relationships. You will have the authority and independence to ensure that requirements, communication opportunities, and risks are identified, managed, and completed in a timely fashion to achieve on-time completion of key deliverables.

Collaborating in lockstep with Product Marketing to define campaign objectives, align on strategies, and establish baseline briefs.
Partnering closely with the Media team to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs/GAs, and optimize local/regional media plans.
Working closely with Creative teams and agencies to analyze performance data and execute real-time creative pivots, A/B testing, and message testing when applicable.
Owning and managing the digital and Dotcom integration for your initiatives—ensuring seamless user journeys, landing page alignment, appointment-booking functionality, and strong cross-functional digital execution.
Authoring, owning, and presenting strategic briefs, local pilot presentations, and deck updates for multiple LOBs and leadership stakeholders.
Synthesizing media performance and local event ROI (GAs, leads, engagement) to share regular results, updates, and strategic recommendations out to leadership.
Managing complex, multi-faceted timelines with exceptional organizational skills to ensure all deliverables stay on strategy and on deadline.
Leading and supporting additional high-priority IMC initiatives and cross-functional projects outside of Wireline marketing as needed by the business.
Maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging trends to fill knowledge gaps and refine marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For…

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience working cross-functionally across Digital/Dotcom, Field Sales/Marketing, Product Marketing, and/or Media teams.
B2B Marketing experience.
Experience creating and presenting executive-level decks, performance readouts, and strategic briefs to Sr. Director-level leadership and above.
Experience translating market insights and data into compelling stories and sales enablement tools.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Master’s degree; preferably MBA.
Marketing experience in Wireline marketing, targeting Enterprise customers and prospects.
Experience working closely with Media and Creative teams to evaluate live campaign metrics and execute iterative creative pivots.
Strong organizational skills and proven ability to juggle multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot) to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support decision-making.
ABM/DBM/Content syndication experience.
Agency or consultant experience.
Proven digital/Dotcom marketing background with a solid understanding of web journeys, lead conversion pathways, and digital trends.
Strong project management background with high attention to detail and process optimization.
Agile mindset with the ability to easily adapt and step in on high-visibility adjacent projects.
Must be a team player and highly effective communicator capable of building strong cross-functional relationships.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. What We Do

As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

The Opportunity

Private markets continue to open to new investor bases, and the way capital is raised is being rewritten. Institutions are deepening their allocations. Evergreen and interval structures, expanding wealth platforms and advisor demand are bringing private markets to investors who have never had access before. The firms that win will understand every client segment better than anyone else and show up for each one with the right story, the right experience and the right timing.

The Head of Channel Marketing is a newly created role responsible for translating the firm’s commercial priorities into tailored marketing solutions for each client segment. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this leader will work with Marketing, Client Solutions, Product and Investment to identify where growth will come from, then design and execute the full-funnel programs that capture it.

The role owns segmentation and audience strategy, and uses client insight, pipeline data and campaign performance to direct marketing investment toward the segments, platforms and accounts with the greatest opportunity. The Head of Channel Marketing is accountable for commercial outcomes, including pipeline created and influenced, conversion, assets raised, and client retention, and will build the strategy, team and processes for the channel marketing team.

Your Responsibilities Will Be To

Define and own the channel marketing strategy and multi-year roadmap for each priority segment, tied to the firm’s commercial goals
Own audience strategy across institutional and private wealth, and continually refine it with client insight, market intelligence and performance data

Design full-funnel, multi-channel programs that drive awareness, engagement, conversion and retention across the client lifecycle, with clear targets for lead generation, pipeline and assets raised
Support the full product and client lifecycle, from launch and capital raising through ongoing education, retention and expansion
Build a trusted partnership with Client Solutions, aligning segment priorities, pipeline goals and coverage models, and provide the teams with the content, tools and insight they need to win
Establish shared lead definitions, hand-offs and feedback loops between Marketing and Sales
Set measurable goals and KPIs for every campaign/program, and report on engagement, pipeline contribution, conversion, assets raised and marketing ROI
Own channel budgets and manage agency and media partners, from brief through delivery, reallocating investment based on performance

Your Background Will Include

12+ years of marketing experience in asset management, private markets, alternatives or wealth management, with at least 5 years leading teams
A record of building from scratch: a channel strategy, a segmentation model, a team or a function that did not exist before you, and the results it delivered
Proven commercial impact, with specific outcomes you can point to, such as pipeline created, conversion improved, or assets raised
Experience owning segmentation and audience strategy, and shifting budget toward the segments and accounts that produce growth
Hands-on use of AI, automation and marketing technology to launch faster, personalize at scale and improve campaign performance, with results you can quantify
Command of investment products, client segments, distribution partners and the regulatory requirements for marketing in financial services; experience across institutional and wealth or intermediary audiences is a plus
Strong digital, CRM, marketing automation and analytics skills, and the judgment to turn data into decisions
Clear, concise communication of complex investment ideas to different audiences
Experience managing budgets and agency partners

About Banana Republic

Banana Republic is a storyteller’s brand, outfitting the modern explorer with high-quality, expertly crafted collections made to inspire and enrich life’s journeys. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager to be an essential role in continuous development, optimization and support for Banana Republic’s CRM and retention strategies. This data-driven, customer-focused individual will be an integral part of the CRM Retention marketing team whose objective is to understand customer behaviors that drive long term value, loyalty and engagement and identify opportunities for personalization across the customer lifecycle.

What you'll do

Own the lifecycle roadmap

Own the lifecycle and triggered program portfolio across Email, SMS, & Push (including high-intent behavioral triggers, post-purchase and order communications, low in stock, and loyalty) across all verticals, including BR Specialty and BR Factory, with a distinct plan for each customer.
Prioritize the highest-value customer moments over program count. Make the call on what to build, scale, fix, or stop.
Own lifecycle across Email, SMS, and Push so programs work together across channels, not alongside each other.

Diagnose performance and tell the story

Own program-level performance reporting and know it cold. Diagnose what is moving and why, including year-over-year and week-over-week changes.
Separate real efficiency gains from mix shifts and volume effects, and attributed demand from incremental demand.
Reconcile data across sources and validate your numbers before they reach leadership.
Translate results into clear business implications for senior leaders: what happened, why it matters, and what we are doing about it.

Test and learn

Build and run a test agenda tied to real strategic questions: what is incremental, which customer should receive what, and how much communication is productive.
Read results carefully, know what a test actually proved, and make a clear scale, modify, or stop recommendation.

Move toward customer-level contact strategy

Help shape how we decide the best communication for a customer when they qualify for several at once.
Evaluate decisions on demand, engagement, and file health together, not demand alone.
Work with analytics and CRM partners to deepen personalization where it creates measurable value.

Execute with rigor

Run program builds, launches, and QA end to end with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, and our technology and vendor partners.
Manage timelines and hold partners accountable. Escalate early, with a recommendation attached.

Direct Mail (Retention)

Full end-to-end management of our retention Direct Mail program, including audience selection, creative briefing, execution and measuring incrementality and ROI.

Who you are

What Great Looks Like

Independent. You take an ambiguous problem from question to recommendation with minimal direction, and you bring solutions when you flag issues.
Strategic. You connect the tactical decision to the bigger customer and business question.
Analytical and precise. You are comfortable in the data, you check your own work, and you are careful not to claim more than the data supports.
An owner. Results, quality, and follow-through are yours, and partners trust you to deliver.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
5+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, preferably in retail or e-commerce
Hands-on experience owning triggered or lifecycle programs in an email service provider or marketing automation platform, as well as SMS and Push platforms for retail.

Working knowledge of test design and incrementality, and the judgment to separate correlation from causation

Proven ability to work across teams and navigate a large company
Customer-obsessed, with a bias toward action

To build your video marketing or social media portfolio.

Today, tridorian operates across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the US, serving customers from startups to enterprise organizations. As we continue to grow, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to help shape the future of cloud, data, AI, and cybersecurity.

We believe great companies are built on great relationships.

Our culture is grounded in three core values:
Curiosity
: We continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and seek better solutions.
Trust
: We act with transparency, accountability, and ownership.
Courage
: We embrace challenges, drive change, and pursue ambitious goals.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing your expertise, collaborating with talented colleagues, and helping drive our continued growth and success. You'll be empowered to take ownership, develop your skills, and play an important role in shaping the future of tridorian.

About the Role

This is a new, permanent Field Marketing Manager role based in the USA, focusing on North America. You will be a mid-to-senior individual contributor responsible for driving our go-to-market strategies through impactful events, partner marketing, and sales enablement collateral.

Main Responsibilities

Own and maintain the North America event and campaign calendar, ensuring visibility and alignment with sales and leadership.
Plan and execute a variety of events across the US and Canada, managing content, agenda, speakers, and attendee experience.
Manage and report on partner marketing funds, including application, compliance, and budget utilization.
Develop and coordinate sales-facing collateral, including call scripts, sales talk tracks, one-pagers, and pitch decks.
Collaborate with the global marketing team to ensure alignment on brand initiatives and messaging.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including sales teams, Google, and external vendors.
Track event performance and report on pipeline and engagement impact.

Required Experience

4+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, or event marketing, preferably within a B2B tech or SaaS environment.
Proven experience managing co-op/partner marketing funds (MDF, PSF, or similar), including compliance and reporting.
Demonstrated success in planning and executing in-person events such as roundtables, dinners, and executive briefings.
Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies across different market segments, industries, and decision-maker personas.
Experience working closely with Sales teams to provide localized marketing support aligned with their needs.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, CRM tools, and analytics platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating with external partners and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience within the Google Cloud ecosystem.
Familiarity with marketing for tech companies focused on AI solutions.
Experience with HubSpot and Attio.

About the Team

You'll join a globally distributed Global Marketing Team, spanning EMEA and APAC. We are a collaborative group passionate about building tridorian's brand, thought leadership, events, and demand generation initiatives. We thrive on trust, ownership, and responsibility, working hand-in-hand with local Sales teams to deeply embed ourselves in their planning and execution.

We are a diverse team committed to solving meaningful problems and unlocking the full potential of cloud and AI for our customers. While we are dedicated to our work, we also deeply value collaboration, continuous learning, and building strong professional relationships. We celebrate our collective successes, support each other's growth, and cultivate an environment where everyone can perform at their best.

new_jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Data & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?

Make an impact. Join PMI.

How will you make a difference to PMI?

The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The role defines how marketing, customer, product, and revenue data should be modeled, decides what each metric means, and ensures those definitions are implemented consistently across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language analytics.

The role combines hands-on technical depth with team leadership. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability.

Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context

Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree.
Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification.
Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data.
Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue.
Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions.
Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage.
Own the business questions, expected results, and synonym glossary behind the Verified Query Repository supporting Cortex Analyst and natural-language analytics.
Own the context layer that makes Marketing's data interpretable to analysts and AI agents, including entity descriptions, metric documentation, approved analytical uses, and known limitations of each source.
Diagnose discrepancies across Snowflake, BI, Adobe Analytics, marketing platforms, finance reporting, and operational systems.
Identify gaps in source data, identity resolution, event structures, and dimensional consistency before they become downstream reporting issues.
Define ownership boundaries between source systems, engineered data products, semantic models, and reporting layers.

Team Leadership and Capability

Lead, coach, and develop a team of three to four analysts spanning paid media, customer and lifecycle analytics, and digital analytics.
Set the Marketing Analytics roadmap, allocate the team against it, and manage intake and prioritization from across Marketing.
Establish and enforce analytical standards including SQL quality, peer review, testing, documentation, and reuse.
Review the team's models, queries, and analyses before they reach stakeholders, and hold the quality bar for what gets published.
Grow the team's depth in dimensional modeling, data modeling practice, and analytical rigor through direct coaching and review.
Manage performance, hiring, and development planning for the team.

Marketing Measurement and Performance Analytics

Define and govern core marketing KPIs including revenue, conversion, CAC and CPA, ROAS, retention, funnel progression, pacing to plan, and channel efficiency.
Own the integrity and narrative of recurring executive performance reporting, including monthly business reviews and QBR analytics, with the team producing the underlying analysis.
Determine how platform-reported, attribution-based, financial, and incrementality-based measures reconcile, and establish where each is appropriately used.
Lead attribution, cohort, and incrementality work so it produces decision-grade guidance on marketing investment, building the harder analyses directly.
Own predictive modeling for Marketing, including membership churn and renewal propensity, certification lapse and recertification likelihood, and product and cross-sell propensity, alongside segmentation, lifecycle, and cohort analysis across CRM, web, campaign, commerce, certification, and membership data.
Define the features, target definitions, validation approach, and performance thresholds for predictive models, determine when a score is reliable enough to act on, and establish how scores are refreshed, monitored for drift, and activated in campaign, lifecycle, and retention programs.
Set analytical standards for A/B testing, holdouts, geo experiments, and conversion-lift studies within the marketing analytics practice, including hypotheses, test populations, success metrics, and readouts.
Partner with Product and Marketing to define measurable funnels, customer states, lifecycle stages, and behavioral signals for considered-purchase journeys, and hold a clear distinction between attribution, correlation, prediction, and causal measurement when results are communicated.

Analytics Delivery and Enablement

Govern Marketing's analytical products in enterprise BI and visualization platforms, ensuring definitions are sourced from the semantic layer rather than rebuilt in the tool.
Use Adobe Analytics to investigate digital behavior, traffic, customer journeys, and conversion performance, and work with data from Adobe Experience Platform, CRM, commerce, and paid media systems.
Apply working knowledge of digital event instrumentation, tagging, identity, and schemas to identify measurement and architecture issues at the source, and establish where AI-assisted tooling is applied to SQL development, analysis, documentation, and testing.
Expand governed self-service and AI-assisted analytics for Marketing across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language surfaces, and represent Marketing data and context requirements in the Marketing AI reference architecture.
Define what Marketing data and context AI agents and natural-language tools are permitted to reach, at what grain, and under what access and accuracy controls, and own the evaluation approach that tests answer accuracy before release and monitors it as data and definitions change.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as Marketing's primary analytical counterpart to Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Governance.
Translate business questions into analytical requirements and data-product specifications that engineering can build against.
Partner with Data Engineering on transformation logic, data contracts, source integration, model design, and data-quality requirements.
Partner with Performance Marketing, Brand, Digital, Product, Lifecycle, and Regional Marketing on measurement needs and analytical priorities.
Present analytical findings, performance trends, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Scope of Role

Leads a team of three to four analysts covering marketing, customer, and performance analytics, while personally designing analytical data models and validating them. Accountable for Marketing's business data architecture, metric definitions, context layer, predictive models, and executive performance reporting across certification, membership, e-learning, events, and other product lines.

Hands-on ownership concentrates in data model design, metric reconciliation, predictive model validation, evaluation of analytical accuracy, and diagnosis of cross-system discrepancies. Semantic view implementation sits with the Snowflake team, built to this role's specification. Routine reporting, campaign analysis, and dashboard production sit with the team, under this role's review and standards.

Data Engineering, Technology, and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, platform access, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. Enterprise data governance policy, cataloging, and cross-domain stewardship sit outside this role; the incumbent partners with Data Governance and applies those standards within Marketing.

Role Qualifications

10+ years across marketing analytics, customer analytics, analytics engineering, or related disciplines, including prior leadership of an analytics team.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing an analytics team while remaining hands-on technically.
Working knowledge of ETL and ELT concepts, transformation pipelines, data dependencies, and data-quality controls, with the ability to read, review, and challenge logic developed by engineering teams.
Experience working within layered, dimensional, or medallion data architectures.
Experience integrating and analyzing data across CRM, marketing, digital, commerce, and transactional systems.
Development and governance of analytical products in an enterprise BI platform, preferred.
Customer data platform architecture including identity resolution, event schema design, and audience activation.
Marketing measurement including attribution, experimentation, incrementality, conversion, CAC and CPA, and ROAS, and experience directing or building predictive and propensity models such as churn or retention.
Advanced SQL including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, data profiling, reconciliation, and validation, applied to large-scale datasets.
Working hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform, sufficient to profile, query, validate, and reconcile at scale.
Demonstrated experience designing business and analytical data models, and specifying them for engineering teams to build against.
Dimensional modeling including facts, dimensions, grain, cardinality, slowly changing dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions.
Metric governance, lineage, and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems.
Strong analytical storytelling and executive communication.
Familiarity with semantic layer and context technologies such as Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, dbt Semantic Layer, or Looker, preferred.
Digital analytics using an enterprise web analytics platform, preferred.
dbt or comparable SQL transformation framework, preferred.
Python or R for advanced analysis, automation, or modeling, preferred.
Git and version-controlled analytics development, preferred.
Data testing and observability frameworks, preferred.
Marketing mix modeling, geo experimentation, conversion lift, causal-inference methods, and machine learning applied to churn, propensity, or lifetime value, preferred.
Up to 10% if required.

What you can expect from us

We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you..

Join Us And You’ll Get

an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location.
skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future.
access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience.
flexible options to help balance work time and your time

new_jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Senior Manager
new_jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) team is a part of VBG. This role will be responsible for leading c ross-segment integrated marketing strategies and programs that would include initiatives touching Enterprise, Public Sector, and/or Business Markets across the CMO and Verizon Business Group. You will focus on marketing strategy, execution, performance management, and go-to-market plans relative to product launches, campaign pivots, and product promotions.

In this role, you will work in lockstep with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, CRM, Media, Creative, and Digital/Dotcom teams to build integrated programs in support of our Wireline Business. You will own internal communication of local campaign progress to all stakeholders, agency briefings, and GTM kickoffs while ensuring flawless execution. Additionally, you will serve as a flexible, agile contributor on the team, taking on other key IMC initiatives and special projects as business needs evolve. In this role, you will report to an Associate Director within the IMC segment team.

The IMC Senior Manager will lead the planning, briefing, management, execution, creative optimization, and reporting on Wireline multi-channel campaigns that drive to the sale funnel or direct to digital channels, increase awareness,and build long-term business relationships. You will have the authority and independence to ensure that requirements, communication opportunities, and risks are identified, managed, and completed in a timely fashion to achieve on-time completion of key deliverables.

Collaborating in lockstep with Product Marketing to define campaign objectives, align on strategies, and establish baseline briefs.
Partnering closely with the Media team to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs/GAs, and optimize local/regional media plans.
Working closely with Creative teams and agencies to analyze performance data and execute real-time creative pivots, A/B testing, and message testing when applicable.
Owning and managing the digital and Dotcom integration for your initiatives—ensuring seamless user journeys, landing page alignment, appointment-booking functionality, and strong cross-functional digital execution.
Authoring, owning, and presenting strategic briefs, local pilot presentations, and deck updates for multiple LOBs and leadership stakeholders.
Synthesizing media performance and local event ROI (GAs, leads, engagement) to share regular results, updates, and strategic recommendations out to leadership.
Managing complex, multi-faceted timelines with exceptional organizational skills to ensure all deliverables stay on strategy and on deadline.
Leading and supporting additional high-priority IMC initiatives and cross-functional projects outside of Wireline marketing as needed by the business.
Maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging trends to fill knowledge gaps and refine marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For…

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience working cross-functionally across Digital/Dotcom, Field Sales/Marketing, Product Marketing, and/or Media teams.
B2B Marketing experience.
Experience creating and presenting executive-level decks, performance readouts, and strategic briefs to Sr. Director-level leadership and above.
Experience translating market insights and data into compelling stories and sales enablement tools.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Master’s degree; preferably MBA.
Marketing experience in Wireline marketing, targeting Enterprise customers and prospects.
Experience working closely with Media and Creative teams to evaluate live campaign metrics and execute iterative creative pivots.
Strong organizational skills and proven ability to juggle multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot) to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support decision-making.
ABM/DBM/Content syndication experience.
Agency or consultant experience.
Proven digital/Dotcom marketing background with a solid understanding of web journeys, lead conversion pathways, and digital trends.
Strong project management background with high attention to detail and process optimization.
Agile mindset with the ability to easily adapt and step in on high-visibility adjacent projects.
Must be a team player and highly effective communicator capable of building strong cross-functional relationships.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

Company

Kem Krest is a $600M, certified minority-owned business (MBE) and trusted partner to OEMs for scalable, high-performance supply chain solutions. Kem Krest specializes in complete 4PL services for aftermarket parts and service fluids fulfillment – from sourcing and supplier management, to inventory ownership, through dealer fulfillment.

Well beyond 3PL commodity logistics, Kem Krest offers OEMs bespoke chemical blending and down-packing solutions, the ability to kit complex parts and accessories, regulatory compliance expertise, and a network of more than 15,000 dealer touchpoints. We have over 45 years of experience working with leading OEMs in the Automotive, Heavy-Duty, and Powersports industries, and are supporting a growing number of OEMs in Construction, Mining, and Agriculture. Kem Krest has 11 locations throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Opportunity

Kem Krest is seeking a strategic and hands-on Marketing Manager – OEM to develop and execute marketing programs that build brand awareness, create demand, and drive new business opportunities with OEM decision-makers. This role owns the OEM marketing strategy from audience research and persona development through campaign execution, measurement, and optimization, helping position Kem Krest as the preferred partner for complex aftermarket supply chain and fulfillment solutions.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this fully remote position works closely with Business Development, Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Marketing partners. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable conducting Voice of Customer research, developing strategy, leading agency partners, building demand generation programs, and creating compelling content that influences OEM buying groups. Preference is given to candidates located in the Midwest, with approximately 25–30% travel required for customer visits, industry events, and collaboration across Kem Krest locations.

Responsibilities

Lead OEM marketing strategy and execution to increase brand awareness, demand generation, pipeline growth, and program wins across target industries.
Develop and maintain Voice of Customer programs, including customer interviews, win/loss analyses, surveys, feedback loops, and market intelligence initiatives.
Create and evolve buyer personas and buyer journey maps for OEM purchasing, product, program, aftermarket, supply chain, and operational decision-makers.
Design, launch, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns through digital channels, industry events, thought leadership programs, and executive engagement initiatives.
Build compelling value propositions, campaign themes, content strategies, and customer-facing materials that differentiate Kem Krest from traditional logistics and distribution providers.
Write and develop original marketing content, including thought leadership, case studies, email campaigns, presentations, and sales enablement tools.
Manage agency relationships by creating strategic briefs, evaluating creative output, managing budgets, and ensuring campaign performance aligns with business objectives.
Partner with Digital Marketing and Marketing Operations resources to execute campaigns, maintain data integrity, support automation efforts, and improve reporting capabilities.
Establish performance dashboards and reporting frameworks that measure campaign effectiveness, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI.
Collaborate with Business Development and Account Management teams to support growth strategies, competitive positioning, account expansion opportunities, and program renewals.

Your Contributions

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive B2B marketing experience with ownership of integrated marketing strategies for complex, long-cycle buying environments.
Demonstrated success conducting Voice of Customer research and translating insights into actionable personas, buyer journeys, messaging strategies, and campaign plans.
Deep expertise in demand generation, account-based marketing, lead nurturing, content strategy, sales alignment, and campaign optimization.
Exceptional writing and storytelling skills with experience personally creating marketing copy, thought leadership content, and customer engagement materials.
Experience marketing within automotive, aftermarket, heavy-duty, powersports, industrial, OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or comparable enterprise environments highly preferred.
Hands-on experience with HubSpot, CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, ZoomInfo, Excel, Power BI, and data-driven performance analysis.
Strong project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and manage agency partners in a shared-resource environment.
Excellent communication, presentation, and problem-solving abilities, coupled with curiosity, business acumen, and comfort using AI-enabled tools.

Work with a differentiated market leader offering 45+ years of OEM partnership experience, specialized 4PL solutions, regulatory expertise, and a network of 15,000+ dealer touchpoints.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and strategic Marketing Manager to lead PNCU’s Marketing department and help strengthen our brand, grow member relationships, and support the Credit Union’s continued growth. The ideal candidate will have progressive marketing experience, strong leadership and project management skills, and experience developing and executing successful marketing strategies across multiple channels.

Working in partnership with the SVP, Retail, the Marketing Manager will help establish marketing priorities, lead campaigns and initiatives, evaluate results, identify opportunities, and ensure our marketing efforts support PNCU’s strategic objectives and the communities we serve. We are looking for someone who brings creativity, sound judgment, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to turn ideas and data into effective marketing strategies.

Polish National Credit Union stands strong as a full-service, member-owned credit union, offering a complete line of personal and business banking products and services. Since our inception in 1921, Polish National has grown to meet the needs of our communities. We proudly support the community through non-profit and educational initiatives. An important aspect of all positions at the Credit Union is to fulfill our mission: “To Grow Lasting Relationships to Improve People’s Lives.”

We are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities for all team members. We take pride in offering growth and professional development opportunities that support our employees’ continued success. Our compensation practices allow team members to progress through the salary range over time as they grow in their roles. The actual base pay offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skills, relevant experience, and work location.

Benefits

Polish National Credit Union offers an attractive compensation and benefits package, including health, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, generous 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off Program, Student Loan Repayment Program, and tuition assistance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Our Credit Union is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Equal access to the hiring process, services, and employment is available to all persons.

Requirements

The Marketing Manager, in partnership with the SVP, Retail, leads the Marketing department and is responsible for the development, execution, and evaluation of the Credit Union’s marketing strategies and initiatives. This position oversees the day-to-day operations of the Marketing department and leads multi-channel marketing efforts focused on member acquisition, engagement, retention, cross-selling opportunities, brand awareness, and organizational growth.

The Marketing Manager collaborates with senior leadership and departments throughout the Credit Union to ensure marketing initiatives align with PNCU’s strategic objectives, member needs, and commitment to the communities we serve.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the day-to-day operations of the Marketing department, ensuring projects, campaigns, deadlines, and priorities are effectively managed.
Partner with the SVP, Retail to develop, recommend, and implement strategic marketing plans that support PNCU’s short- and long-term objectives, member needs, and growth opportunities.
Lead the planning, development, execution, and evaluation of multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, social media, print, advertising, and community outreach.
Develop and oversee marketing materials, advertisements, campaigns, promotional materials, and member communications while maintaining consistency with PNCU’s brand and messaging.
Monitor and evaluate campaign performance using marketing metrics and data to identify opportunities and make recommendations for future initiatives.
Conduct market research and analyze member needs, behaviors, market trends, competitive activity, and potential opportunities for growth and cross-selling.
Oversee PNCU’s social media presence and digital content to strengthen member engagement, community awareness, and the Credit Union’s brand and reputation.
Coordinate and oversee promotional, community, and professional events, including planning, marketing support, materials, and implementation.
Develop and maintain relationships with community organizations, business partners, marketing vendors, and other external partners.
Collaborate with senior leadership and departments throughout PNCU to identify marketing needs and develop strategies that support products, services, organizational initiatives, and member growth.
Manage departmental projects and resources and partner with the SVP, Retail regarding Marketing department budget priorities and expenditures.
Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development to Marketing staff while fostering creativity, collaboration, accountability, and professional growth.
Provide the SVP, Retail and senior leadership with updates regarding marketing initiatives, campaign performance, market trends, opportunities, and recommendations.
Maintain responsibility for compliance with applicable federal and state regulations, as well as Credit Union policies and procedures.
Complete all required compliance training and additional ongoing training assigned throughout the year.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong knowledge of marketing strategies, digital marketing tools, techniques, and channels.
Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong strategic planning and project management abilities.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate marketing data and campaign performance and make recommendations based on results.
Experience managing social media and digital content.
Experience with Adobe products and content management systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Ability to effectively manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments.
Ability to effectively manage vendor, community, and business relationships.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field required.

Progressive marketing experience, including experience developing and executing marketing strategies and campaigns, analyzing results, managing multiple projects, and collaborating across an organization.

Supervisory Or Leadership Experience Preferred.

Financial institution or credit union marketing experience preferred.

Interpersonal Skills

A significant level of trust, diplomacy, professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment is required. The Marketing Manager must be able to work collaboratively with the SVP, Retail, senior leadership, employees, vendors, community organizations, business partners, and other external contacts.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership and relationship-building skills, along with the creativity and strategic perspective necessary to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and successfully execute marketing initiatives.

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

Work Environment

Normal office environment. Travel is required for community events, meetings, professional events, and other Credit Union-related activities.
