Hi, we’re Supergoop! Since 2005, we’ve been changing the way the world thinks about sunscreen. Today, we’re as committed as ever to creating feel-good sunscreen that you’ll really want to wear. Because protecting your skin’s health is what we’re all about. Every. Single. Day.™

You are a performance marketer who lives at the intersection of retail media and organic search. You have a strong opinion on which retail media networks deserve investment, how to make a Roundel program sing, and how SEO and paid retail tactics work together to drive both site traffic and retailer sell-through. You’re hyper-organized, analytical, and equally comfortable in a retailer’s media dashboard or a technical SEO audit. You see DTC and retail.com as one connected ecosystem, not two separate channels.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Integrated Media & Measurement, you’ll be part of a fast-paced, innovative team building a best-in-class media program that reflects Supergoop!’s brand values. You will own retail media investment decisions, lead our SEO strategy, partner closely with the DTC and Sales teams, and keep a constant pulse on the evolving retail media and search landscape.

Responsibilities:

Own Supergoop!’s SEO strategy end-to-end — technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and organic keyword performance — to drive qualified traffic and revenue to our DTC site.
Own day-to-day engagement with our retail media partners planning, campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and quarterly business reviews. Act as the primary point of contact between Supergoop!, our retail partners, and our media agency.
Build and execute the retail media investment strategy — recommending which retail media networks to invest in (Roundel, Amazon Ads, Sephora Media Network, Ulta, etc.), at what level, and against which priorities to maximize sell-through and ROAS.
Partner closely with the DTC, Content, and Education teams to ensure that we’re optimized for organic discovery, inclusive of SEO and AEO. Coordinate on landing pages, content, PDP optimization, and cross-channel measurement.
Liaise with retail media network partners and agency contacts to manage day-to-day performance, troubleshoot in-flight, and surface new opportunities.
Analyze performance data across retail media and SEO — ROAS, sell-through, share of voice, organic traffic, keyword rankings — and synthesize insights into clear reporting for senior leadership.
Brief in retail media creative assets and work closely with Creative, Brand, and Project Management to ensure on-brand, on-time delivery and apply best practices for retail-specific performance creative.
Partner with Sales and Retail Marketing to align retail media investment with key account priorities, promotional moments, and CoOp opportunities.

Stay current on beta offerings, emerging retail media networks, and SEO algorithm changes — identify new testing opportunities and bring forward recommendations.
Perform competitive analysis across both retail media presence and organic search to identify gaps and opportunities.

Qualifications/Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Hands-on experience managing retail media network programs; direct experience with Roundel strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon Ads, Sephora Media Network, Ulta, and other beauty retailer networks is a plus.
Strong SEO foundation across technical SEO, content SEO, and on-page optimization.

Experience managing meaningful media budgets and making channel-level investment recommendations.

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, especially with DTC/site, Sales, Creative, and Brand partners.
Curious, detail-oriented, and a self-starter who can operate independently while staying tightly aligned with leadership.

new_jobs.title: Performance Marketing Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Great marketing happens when people who have a problem or a need can connect with great organizations who can help them. When you are marketing at Idaho Youth Ranch, that concept takes on a whole new meaning: Young people and their families come to Idaho Youth Ranch seeking healing and hope from traumas that are keeping them from living up to their full potential.

Our brand is more than colors and fonts on social media. It is about hope and resilience.

The Performance Marketing Strategist at Idaho Youth Ranch plays an essential role in helping connect families and young people who are facing adversity, trauma, and loss with caring adults who will help them get the safety and support they need to heal.

You will be putting your unique talents and skills to work to redefine the future for Idaho’s kids while being part of a supportive team environment.

How does Idaho Youth Ranch view their brand and communications?
Idaho Youth Ranch is a diverse organization with unique marketing needs. From marketing 24 thrift stores, a car lot, and an ecommerce department to managing marketing campaigns for a statewide network of life-changing programs, our Performance Marketing Strategist must be able to see the big picture to help the public understand that when kids need help, we are here and anyone who cares about Idaho’s kids can help through donations, volunteerism, or shopping.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use the elements of branding to tell a cohesive story to anyone who interacts with our organization.

So, who are we?
Since 1953, Idaho Youth Ranch has provided healing and hope for Idaho’s kids. We use proven therapies and programs to help kids who have experienced loss or adversity transform childhood trauma into hope. We offer a statewide network of services to kids 9–24 years old and their families, including outpatient therapies, residential care, adoption services, and career readiness.

The Idaho Youth Ranch is one of the oldest non-profit agencies in the state of Idaho. Our mission:

We unite for Idaho’s youth by providing accessible programs and services that nurture hope, healing, and resilience.

Why unite with us?
Because we are better together! Our team members enjoy a workplace where Relationships
are the foundation, where we are all Committed
to the same mission, where Growth
is always possible, where we are treated with and show Compassion
, where trust guides us to Transparency
, and above all, where Joy
sustains us.

What do we offer?
In addition to contributing to our awesome mission, working at IYR has many advantages! Affordable medical and dental care, other voluntary benefits offerings, a 401(k) match, paid time off, an employee discount on purchases at our thrift stores, and working in a caring and compassionate environment just to name a few.

How will you impact our mission?
Every position at Idaho Youth Ranch contributes to the success of our mission. As the Performance Marketing Strategist, your work directly impacts our ability provide life-changing therapies to the youth we serve. You play a lead role in helping parents of Idaho’s most vulnerable youth learn Idaho Youth Ranch can provide the healing and hope they need. As a leader in our branding, website, and social media, you play a critical role in public understanding and support for Idaho Youth Ranch.

Your design skills and messaging skills play a key role in communication both within Idaho Youth Ranch and in in the broader community. Your work is often the public face of Idaho Youth Ranch and plays an important role in perceptions of Idaho Youth Ranch.

Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or related field
2+ years of digital communications experience
Demonstrated success in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that drive measurable results.
Strong, hands-on Google Ads experience is required, including campaign build and account structure, keyword and audience strategy, Performance Max, budget and bid management, conversion tracking, and performance reporting.
Experience managing a Google Ad Grants (nonprofit) account is preferred, including Ad Grants policy compliance, account structure, and maintaining click-through rate and quality score requirements.
Strong, hands-on Meta ads experience is required, including Meta Ads Manager, audience building and retargeting, creative testing, Pixel and Conversions API tracking, and budget optimization across Facebook and Instagram.
Experience applying paid media to both talent acquisition (recruiting) and retail customer acquisition, with the ability to manage separate campaign strategies and budgets for each.
Working knowledge of TikTok as a marketing channel, including short-form video content and TikTok paid advertising.
Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager to measure, attribute, and report campaign performance.

Our Performance Marketing Strategist Will

Recommend, develop, and execute paid media campaigns to support staff recruiting, including hands-on management of Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, and display) and Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram to drive qualified applicant volume.
Build, manage, and optimize recruiting ad campaigns end to end, including audience targeting, creative and copy testing, budget pacing, bid strategy, and conversion tracking, to reduce cost per qualified applicant and shorten time to fill.
Grow and manage TikTok as a core social enterprise channel, producing short-form video content, leveraging trends and creator partnerships, and running TikTok paid placements to reach thrift shoppers and vehicle donors.
Provides paid media execution support for client acquisition campaigns as assigned, reaching families and referral sources seeking Idaho Youth Ranch services.
Supports growth by developing and executing comprehensive marketing plans to drive customer acquisition, retention, and sales growth for thrift stores
Produces and publishes social media content for recruiting and social enterprise business areas, working within the organization-wide social media strategy, calendar, and channel governance maintained elsewhere in the department.

As a 501(c)(3) Non-Profit, the Idaho Youth Ranch is a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PLSF) program. The PLSF offers student loan forgiveness on qualifying loans under specific conditions. Speak with your loan provider for more information.

This position is in Idaho and candidates must be within a reasonable distance to our location.

The Idaho Youth Ranch is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
National Forest Foundation (NFF)
is pleased to offer an exempt, full-time position who will be responsible for managing NFF's social media presence including strategy, content, community, and results. The Social Media Manager is a chance for a curious, culture-obsessed storyteller and strategist who sees endless possibility to grow NFF's social presence into the online place people visit to fall in love with forests, deepening this appreciation for themselves and, ultimately, supporting the NFF so we can preserve these landscapes for future generations.

About the NFF:
The National Forest Foundation, chartered by Congress in 1990, is the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS). In recent years, the Foundation has grown significantly in organizational capacity, revenue, and programmatic impact. Today, the NFF works with people, partners and communities across the country to restore forests and watersheds; make forests more resilient to wildfire; and ensure accessible and sustainable opportunities for recreation in our National Forests. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country's 193-million-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals building toward a bold future: a world where caring for our forests is second nature.

Position Function:
The Social Media Manager reports to the Marketing Director and is a growth-oriented position for someone who finds a way to turn NFF's mission and on-the-ground impact into scroll-stopping, share-worthy stories, with a particular emphasis on video. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, the Content & Creative team, and teams across the organization, this role considers the “we over me” approach to collaboration and translates local conservation projects into stories that resonate locally and nationally. Success will be measured by growth in reach, engagement, and community.

Position Duties and Responsibilities:
The Social Media Manager will:

Social Media Strategy & Growth

Develop and own an audience-centered organic social media strategy aligned with NFF's brand, marketing and advancement priorities and organizational goals
Assess target audience, distinct platform fit, and strategic priorities to decide where NFF should invest, which channels get full strategic and day-to-day ownership, and which get a lighter footprint, and evolve that approach over time as audiences and platforms shift
Establish channel-specific objectives, key performance indicators and growth targets, and demonstrate measurable growth in reach, engagement, followers, and other measurable audience actions
Monitor platform changes, audience behavior, cultural conversations and emerging trends to keep NFF's presence current, relevant and a step ahead
Develop and maintain an integrated social media content calendar aligned with high-level marketing strategy, organizational strategy, conservation priorities, seasonal moments and audience interests
Partner with NFF's growth marketing agency, sharing data, learning outcomes and insight that fuels larger acquisition and fundraising campaigns

Analytics, Testing & Optimization

Monitor and analyze channel, content, audience and campaign performance, and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations
Design and run structured tests across formats, creative approaches, messages and calls to action; document findings and apply learning going forward
Identify the organic content that resonates most, and use a designated amplification budget to extend its reach to new and existing audiences
Build and maintain social media dashboards and reports that communicate results, lessons learned and opportunities to drive goals; recommend key performance indicators that support marketing and organization-wide strategy

Community, Creator & Influencer Engagement

Manage NFF's social communities daily, responding to comments and messages, encouraging conversation, and cultivating relationships with followers, fans and supporters
Use social listening to understand audience interests, monitor sentiment, and uncover emerging engagement opportunities as well as potential risks to reputation
Own direct relationship management with a select set of creators and community voices, while partnering with NFF's influencer agency of record, which leads vetting, contracting and logistics for broader creator and influencer campaigns
Apply sound judgment when responding to marketplace influences, misinformation or sensitive issues, and follow escalation and response protocols for emerging or rapidly developing situations

Content Creation

Translate complex conservation projects and technical subject matter into clear, actionable creative briefs to inspire engaging and share-worthy content development
Oversee and guide social content development, inspiring content creators to consider scroll-stopping hooks, pacing, narrative structure and calls to action aligned with each platform
Create compelling, platform-native content including copy, graphics, photography and, especially, short-form video, adapting stories and assets to the audience, format and best practices of each platform
Build strong relationships across NFF to maintain a steady pipeline of timely, representative and geographically diverse stories to fuel storytelling across social platforms
Build familiarity with wide-ranging creative assets and identify opportunities to repurpose video, photography or copy into multiple platform-specific formats
Serve as a brand steward, ensuring social content is consistent with NFF's voice, look and feel; maintain accuracy, accessibility and editorial standards across all social content

Collaboration

Collaborate with email, web, fundraising, communications, partnerships and field teams to build coordinated, cross-channel campaigns
Ensure social media supports email acquisition, donor engagement, fundraising and program participation without directly owning those functions
Share social media guidance, content co-creation ideas and performance insights with colleagues, partners and key stakeholders

Education and Qualifications:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following education and experience:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of experience managing social media, developing dashboards and making data-informed decisions for a national brand, with a track record of significant organic audience growth
Experience using a designated budget to boost or amplify organic content, and comfort partnering with an agency on broader paid social campaigns
Proficiency with social media management and scheduling tools, social listening tools, and analytics platforms (e.g., Meta Business Suite, native platform analytics, Sprout Social, Google Analytics or similar)
Strong hands-on video production and editing skills, including short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook
Experience collaborating with outside agencies, freelancers or contractors
Must be authorized to work in the United States

Abilities and Skills:
NFF expects the Social Media Manager to bring the following abilities and skills:

Deeply curious and addicted to culture and what's trending, someone who doesn't just find the inspiration, but delivers it for others
Strategic thinker who can weigh audience, platform and data to decide where to invest, then adapt that thinking as things change
Natural storyteller with a filmmaker's eye for the shot, sound and moment that stops the scroll
Collaborative partner who values diverse input and works comfortably with agencies, creators and teams across the organization
Owns and advocates for audience-first perspective; listens to community feedback and adjusts tone and approach; warm, welcoming and inclusive communicator
Self-starter comfortable with ambiguity and energized by change; treats every test, win or miss as a chance to learn and grow
Sees the big picture, connecting everyday content to NFF's long-term mission and impact
Exercises sound judgment on sensitive or reputationally sensitive topics
Growth mindset with a bias toward action and follow-through

Location:
This is a remote/work-from-home position open to candidates in the lower 48 states. Reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace are required. Occasional travel for team gatherings or content capture may be expected.

Compensation:
NFF offers a competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects our total rewards strategy. The salary range for this position is $95,000 with the ability to grow to $118,750 based on performance over time. Starting salary within this range is determined by a combination of experience, internal equity with comparable roles, and organizational budget, and is assessed annually as part of NFF's compensation review process.

Benefits:
NFF is proud to offer our staff:

Health and Wellness

Medical and dental insurance paid at 75% by the organization for you and any dependents
Vision insurance paid 50% by the organization for you and any dependents
Health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, predicated on coverage type
Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Employee assistance program (EAP) at no cost

Financial Wellbeing

403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match after one (1) year of service
Short-term and long-term disability insurance at no cost
Basic life and AD&D insurance at no cost, with voluntary life insurance options

Flexibility and Time Off

Employees start with 35 days of annual leave, sick leave, personal leave and holidays
Family & medical leave for up to sixteen (16) weeks with up to four (4) weeks paid

Personal Development

Training & Development Programs
Professional development reimbursement up to $1,000 per year

Journey of a Lifetime

The opportunity to support an incredible mission and travel to / work in spectacular locations

To Apply:
Applications must include both a cover letter and resume. Incomplete packages will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting will close on November, 21st, or earlier if filled. Please visit our careers site to apply online.
